title: Make the JD-reading step converge instead of oscillating
summary: Baseline run 2 stopped because the JD extraction was rejected three times. Fixes: personal qualifications can pass the faithfulness check; section headings are no longer coverage passages; each retry revises its previous draft.
body: Observed in jobs/scaleway-baseline-jd-20260927T202451669539Z: (1) soft-skill components quoted exactly were judged unfaithful because the question required a concrete action/input/integration/control/output; the question now also accepts a stated qualification or personal requirement, still tied to its exact quote. (2) Headings such as 'AI Tooling Engineering' and 'SOFT SKILLS:' were flagged MISSING; lines of at most four words that end in ':' or are all capitalised words without end punctuation are excluded. On the saved run this removes 6 of 73 passages, all headings. (3) Retries regenerated from scratch, so fixes in one draft were lost in the next; retries now receive previous_draft and must keep uncriticised parts. Real omissions (promoting Scaleway's own cloud internally, the role's autonomy/team-building, the DSI context) must still be fixed by the model. Includes Codex's unfinished earlier work in the same file (passage coverage checks, bounded Jev batches, detailed corrections, parent-quote fallback), reviewed and kept. Tests: skills 10 pass; full suite 117 pass. Offline tests cannot show that Jev will now accept the draft; only the rerun can.
